name: Turkey Chili with Cheddar, Cilantro, Guacamole & Lime (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes 4 medium and 4 small food storage containers.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 stick celery
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and medium dice celery. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion; peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey and spices to the pot. Continue to cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 4-5 minutes more.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lb ground turkey
2 tbsp chili powder
2 tsp cumin, ground
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, stir to combine the chili, and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, 8-10 minutes. (If you prefer a looser chili, add up to 1 cup water if desired.)
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Divide between the small storage containers.
Cut lime into wedges, add to the storage containers with the cilantro, along with cheese and a guacamole cup. Cover and refrigerate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ⅓ cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
4 (2 oz) cup guacamole

instructions.primary_message: When the chili is done, remove from heat, divide between medium storage containers, and set aside to cool completely. Once cool, cover and refrigerate. When ready to eat, reheat chili in a microwave or saucepan, then top with cheese, cilantro, guacamole, and a squeeze of lime. Enjoy!
